Header.description: Face Descriptors Object Header – Standard PAF-FDO-Vx.y

MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) where this Face is or is intended to be located.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) where this Face is or is intended to be located.

FaceDescriptorsObjectID.description: Unique identifier of this Face Descriptors Object instance.

FaceDescriptorsObjectTime.description: Time this Face Descriptors Object was produced.

FaceDescriptorsObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Face is located.

FaceDescriptorsData.description: Face Descriptors Data representing facial features of an Entity.

DataLength.description: Length of the Face Descriptors Data.

DataURI.description: URI reference to the Face Descriptors Data.

DataID.description: Identifier referencing Face Descriptors Data stored elsewhere.

FaceDescriptorsQualifier.description: Qualifier providing information on Sub-Types, Formats, and Attributes of Face Descriptors Data.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Face Descriptors Object in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Face Descriptors Object (plain text, max 2048 characters).
